description:
Minimum of 4 years of experience with Spring MVC 4.0 or higher

7-6 years of experience with Java and OO concepts

Experience in configuring/working with Spring MVC using annotations

Experience configuring and using Spring Boot

Experience with persistence provider like Hibernate or JPA (preferred is JPA).

Experience with developing & consuming REST APIs.

Knowledge on developing test cases & testing using JUnit.

4-5 years of experience working with relational databases via Spring.

Working knowledge of JSON.

Experience with development tools: Eclipse, Maven and SVN.

Able to take specification and turn it into working code with little oversight.

At least basic level understating of http and database caching techniques.

Ability to set priorities, adapt to change, and meet established timelines.

 Nice to Have




Knowledge on Spring Security.

Knowledge in deploying the Spring Application to application server like Weblogic.

Hands on experience on Oracle SQL and PLSQL.

Knowledge on Integrating REST services with Angular Js/Java script based application.

Knowledge on continuous integration with Jenkins. 



 Skill :  JAVA, Spring4.x, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
